speaker: Cid
narration: Oh wait... I don't think you can understand a word I'm saying. ...Do you understand me NOW?

speaker: Cid
narration: Ha! I knew it — you're the new recruit. Here, take this — it's called the Translator.

speaker: Cid
narration: Our world speaks Japanese. You obviously don't. That's where the Translator comes in.

speaker: Cid
narration: Every creature, human, and item here is Japanese. The Translator will simplify things for you.

speaker: Cid
narration: The Translator will automatically show the pronunciation above any Japanese word, and the definition below.

speaker: Cid
narration: If you get lost, you can always tap any Japanese word inside a dialogue box to see the full definition.

speaker: Cid
narration: But enough talking - let's get right into your first adventure.

speaker: Cid
narration: Every adventurer needs a companion. Here, take this Fire creature.

speaker: Cid
narration: Now let's head to the Starting Meadow for your first exploration!
